title: The muzzle flash is parented to the barrel, not to the world
note: Exactly one object tagged muzzle, parented under the weapon so it moves with the barrel instead of floating in the frame.
intent: A flash emitter left in world space stays where the barrel was, which reads as a light hanging in the air. Create exactly one object tagged muzzle, add it as a child of the weapon group at the end of the barrel, and drive its visibility and scale from the fire event rather than from a timer of its own. One emitter, not one per shot: reuse it and reset its life. The same rule holds for the shell ejector and any smoke socket.

check.js: count('muzzle') === 1 && (() => { let p = objects('muzzle')[0].parent, ok = false; while (p) { if (p.userData && p.userData.tag === 'weapon') ok = true; p = p.parent; } return ok; })()
check.note: Exactly one object tagged muzzle (the flash/emitter) and it is parented under the weapon, so it moves with the barrel instead of floating in the frame.

port: The weapon facet parents the muzzle under the weapon group at build time; the firing code only toggles it.
